notes.title: Gaps 1.3.1 - Start melodies on any degree
notes.content:
The melodies exercise can now start in any random degree instead of always from the root note.

Bug fixes:
- Multiple clicks screwing up the exercise when using the mouse on the melodies exercise.
- Can no longer click spacebar while holding a note on the guitar during the melodies exercise.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.3 - Various minor improvements
notes.content:
* New volume values so guitar is louder in the mix.
* Added a discord button.
* Fix for leaving an exercise while holding a note screwing things up.
* Fix audio click when going to new question during the melodies exercise.
* Hitting 'hear drone' now doesn't affect the current loop if it's playing.
* Melodies 'hear drone' default value now depends on monitoring value.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.2 - Melodies improvements
notes.content:
Lots of small improvements to the melodies exercise:

[u]Melodies:[/u]
* The degrees are now selected individually, no longer using scales. Similarly to how it is like in the degrees exercise. 
* Added the full names for each degree under the hexagons.
* Fixed score display for ES language.
* Added a hear drone option like the one present in the degrees exercise.
* You now can't get the same degree twice in a row.
* Fixed spacebar not reseting the exercise progress.

[u]Other changes:[/u]
* Added example degrees on the fretboard like the ones in the interval exercise.
* Made the degrees and interval full text bigger so it's easier to read.
* Added ES language degree names.
* Re-ordered the exercises so that degrees come on by default as it's going to be the main focus of the application along with melodies from now on.
* Fix for some interval examples not showing up when the max fret size was set to a low number.
* Fix hold button for drone not working when interacting with it using the mouse.
* Lowered drone note volume.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.1 - Redo improvements
notes.content:
* Redo option is now infinite. If you miss your quesition again during your redo session, the question will be added again at the end of the queue until you get it right. This removes the annoying step of having to enter multiple redo sessions until you got all of the questions right.
* Fixed a bug where the redo option for intervals would sometimes glitch the audio.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.0 - Degrees exercise rework
notes.content:
The degrees exercise has been reworked. When before Gaps would play a drone note for you and show all of its positions on the fretboard, it now shows you only one of them. You'll need to find the degree note that's played on that position instead of wherever you wanted, as you could do before. This will help train you to find degrees on different positions. 
You also get an arrow indicating if the degree needs to be found ascending from the root note or descending from it, which is very useful if you're doing the degrees exercise in the ascending + descending mode.

Besides these changes, various bugs and fixes have been addressed:
- Drone note randomly missing while advancing through the questions.
- Hold note for drone sometimes not working.
- Re-do questions are cleared when switching exercises and modes.

Also a new Android version has been released, you can find info on it at [url=https://gapsguitar.com/]https://gapsguitar.com/[/url]

notes.title: Gaps 1.0.1 - Max fret option and minor bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new option in the settings menu to set the number of frets on your guitar, so that Gaps will now only generate intervals, degrees and melodies within those frets.
[*] Fixed a bug where the microphone would pick up the audio from the speakers on the first question of a redo of a degrees exercise.
[*] Fixed a bug where the 'minor' setting on the melodies exercise would contain the wrong intervals.

More info/support at [url=https://gapsguitar.com/]gapsguitar.com[/url]

[/list]

notes.title: Gaps 1.0.0 - Full version released!
notes.content:
Fixed some small bugs and performance issues.
Re-do now correctly works on the intervals exercise.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.12 - Various fixes and improvments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Gaps no longer crashes when the system has more than 10 inputs or outputs
[*] Fixed a bug where after playing the degrees exercise two times in a row, the re-do notes would get messed up.
[*] Drone note and the first melody note now start simultaneously on the melodies exercise.
[*] Added a simple log system to debug audio problems. If you ever get any crashes you can find the logs at C:\Users\YOUR_USER\AppData\Local\Gaps\log.txt . If you send me this I'll help you with your problem.
[/list]

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.11 - Device settings improvments
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Save selected input and output devices in user settings.
[*] Fix device change forcing exclusive mode
[*] Fix non matching input/output sample rates producing pitch shifted notes
[/list]

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.10 - Input and output device settings
notes.content:
Added an input and output device settings section. Now you can use different devices than the Windows default ones.

Fixes the program crashing at launch when an audio stream can't be opened with the default devices.

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.9 - New "Melodies" exercise
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new Melodies mode. Practice playing entire melodies by ear.
[*] Fixed audio glitching when closing the application.
[/list]

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.8 - Improved degrees exercise
notes.content:
[b]Improved degrees exercise:[/b]

[list]
[*] Replay incorrect questions at the end of a round.
[*] Option to turn off the root note playback and hear it only when pressing ctrl. This allows you to use the exercise with a laptop and an internal mic.
[*] Fixed notes higher than E6 being generated.
[*] Fixed some random crashes.
[/list]

notes.title: Gaps 1.1.7 released
notes.content:
Added a new practice mode that lets you practice scale degrees against a drone note.
